content.text:
I didn't pick one. This page just lists names and never shows what anything costs, so I'm not sure of anything.

**Voice message to a friend:**

"Ok so, I didn't decide anything. I opened this site, 'מקור', on the tab 'חברות ומסלולים'. It's dark and looks modern, so at least I didn't swipe away straight off. The title is 'מה חברה מציעה לי'. Then it's just a long list. First 'בתי השקעות': אי.בי.אי, אלטשולר שחם, הפניקס, מגדל, all of them. Under each name there's this run of small words like 'קרן השתלמות · קופת גמל להשקעה · תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים…'. Half of those I don't even know.

The only one that sounded like a normal account for buying stuff was 'חשבון ניירות ערך', I think? It's under אי.בי.אי and Interactive Brokers, and I've actually heard of Interactive Brokers from TikTok.

Then 'בנקים ובתי השקעות נוספים': Leumi, Hapoalim, Discount, Pepper, One Zero. Under each one there's only 'תעריפון מ־01.10.2026', and for some it says 'ללא תאריך פרסום'. Like… cool, there's a price list, but what's the actual fee?? No number anywhere. I wanted to see what it costs to put 500 a month in, and there's nothing.

Then it jumps to another list: BlackRock, iShares, Nasdaq, S&P Dow Jones Indices, each with a little number like '4' next to it and a fold arrow. No idea what the number means, and I didn't open them. Then some grey paragraph, 'לא נכלל בכלל', which I didn't read, and that's the end.

I'd basically have closed it at the bank list, when I realised no fees were showing. If I had to choose right now I'd lean Interactive Brokers because I know the name, but honestly that's a guess."

**Short account:**
- **What I looked at, in order:** the title, the 'בתי השקעות' list (only the names, plus 'חשבון ניירות ערך'), the 'בנקים ובתי השקעות נוספים' list, then the BlackRock/iShares/Nasdaq/S&P list.
- **What I skipped:** all the folds, the grey paragraph under 'לא נכלל בכלל', and the footer.
- **Where I hesitated:** I wasn't sure 'חשבון ניירות ערך' is the account I need. I also didn't know what the small numbers next to the fund names meant. Some part of the page between the bank list and the fund-name list got skipped in my scrolling, and I never saw its heading.
- **What bothered me:** there's no fee or price anywhere. 'תעריפון' just shows a date. And every company has a wall of product words I don't know.
